name: Reservi Booking System
short_description: Plantilla completa de reservas online con landing publica, flujo de reserva, detalle/cancelacion de cita y admin privado para agenda, calendario, servicios, recursos, clientes y ajustes.
long_description: Vertical mixed para negocios que funcionan con cita previa: barberias, estudios de estetica, consultores, academias pequenas, salas por horas, servicios profesionales y experiencias con disponibilidad. Incluye landing publica, pagina de reserva por servicio, lookup/cancelacion publica por codigo, login de staff y panel privado con dashboard, reservas, calendario, servicios, recursos/staff, clientes, bloqueos de tiempo, ajustes y usuarios admin. Stack Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 3 + shadcn/ui + react-router-dom. Backend completo con settings, resources, services, service_resources, availability_rules, time_blocks, customers, bookings y booking_status_events; endpoints publicos para servicios/disponibilidad/reserva/cancelacion y endpoints admin para gestionar toda la operacion.

first_message_examples: Quiero una app para que mis clientes reserven cita online
Necesito una web con agenda y panel para gestionar reservas
Hazme un sistema de reservas para mi negocio con servicios y horarios
Quiero que los clientes elijan servicio, profesional y hora
Necesito un panel para ver reservas, calendario, clientes y servicios
Crea algo tipo Calendly pero con mi marca y admin privado
Quiero una landing con boton de reservar y una agenda interna
Haz una app de booking con disponibilidad y cancelacion por codigo
negative_examples: Una tienda online con productos, carrito y pagos
Una radio o podcast con programacion
Una clinica con historial medico completo
Un restaurante con carta QR y comandas
Un CRM generico sin agenda de citas
Una landing simple sin gestion interna
best_for: Negocios con cita previa donde el flujo principal es elegir servicio, profesional/recurso y horario.
Servicios locales que necesitan una landing publica y una agenda privada que funcione desde el primer build.
Casos donde hacen falta recursos/staff, disponibilidad, bloqueos, clientes, cancelacion y estados de reserva.
Base solida para adaptar a barberia, estetica, consultoria, clases privadas o alquiler por horas.
not_for: Clinicas con historial medico complejo, recetas o expedientes clinicos avanzados.
Restaurantes con carta QR, mesas y comandas.
Tiendas online con carrito, inventario y envios.
Apps puramente editoriales, radios, podcasts o noticias.
Landings simples sin necesidad de admin ni reservas reales.

agent_decision_signals.ambiguous_signal_action: Prefer this template when the user needs a public booking flow plus admin calendar/service/customer management.

access_profile.notes: Public landing and booking flow are open. Dashboard, calendar, services, resources, customers, settings and admin users are protected.

routes.name: Book Service
routes.purpose: Public booking flow preselected by service.

routes.name: Booking Detail

frontend_contract.ui_system: Radix primitives, lucide-react, sonner, React Query

guidance: Public endpoints are for service listing, availability, booking creation, lookup and cancellation.
Admin endpoints require authenticated staff/admin and power the dashboard/calendar/CRUD pages.
Do not duplicate booking tables or endpoints; adapt existing Reservi contracts.

tables.name: resources
tables.purpose: Staff, rooms or equipment used for bookings.

tables.name: bookings
tables.purpose: Booking records with status, source, price and timing.

customization_targets.description: Business name, tagline, contact details and admin app name.
Public service selection, availability display, booking form and cancellation/lookup copy.
Service names, durations, prices, buffers and resource assignment.
Admin dashboard, booking management, calendar, customers and settings.
HSL design tokens for brand palette.

default_first_screen.shape: Premium service-business landing with service cards, team/resources, booking CTA, FAQ and contact details.
default_first_screen.data_strategy: Use baked DYPAI seed data for services/resources/settings, then adapt copy, services and prices to the user's business.
default_first_screen.interaction: Public CTA opens /book; booking creation calls real public endpoints; admin pages call protected endpoints.

backend_expectations: list-public-services returns settings, services and resources.

already_included: Mixed public + admin booking system with public landing, booking flow, booking lookup/cancel page, and protected admin shell.
Public endpoints for services, availability, booking creation, booking lookup and cancellation.
Private admin endpoints for bookings, customers, services, resources, time blocks, settings and admin users.
Booking schema with settings, services, resources, availability rules, time blocks, customers, bookings, booking status events and notifications.
Code-file endpoints for complex booking operations; SQL-file endpoints for dashboard/listing queries.
adaptation_steps: Adapt Landing.tsx, Book.tsx and src/lib/app-config.ts to the user's business, services, staff/resources and tone.
Preserve the public booking flow and connect changes to existing booking endpoints instead of creating duplicate reservation endpoints.
Adapt admin pages only where the user's booking model needs different fields or terminology.
Keep public endpoints public and admin endpoints JWT-protected.
Verify the booking flow and admin pages compile after changes.
do_not_rebuild: Do not create duplicate booking tables or duplicate reservation endpoints.
Do not replace the booking availability logic unless the user explicitly asks for a different scheduling model.
Do not remove ProtectedRoute/admin auth boundaries.
Do not create custom auth endpoints; reuse DYPAI auth.
agent_brief.first_build_goal: A branded booking landing and working public booking flow adapted to the user's service business, while preserving the existing admin booking operations.
completion_checks: The agent reused existing booking endpoints and tables.
Any new public form endpoint remains auth_mode public; admin operations remain JWT-protected.

must_reuse: create-public-booking and get-availability for public booking
DYPAI auth and ProtectedRoute for admin
may_extend: Add business-specific fields to services/resources/customers/bookings if needed
Add notifications, deposits or payment endpoints in a later iteration
must_not_duplicate: Do not create a second bookings/reservations table
Do not create duplicate public booking endpoints
Do not create custom auth tables/endpoints

image_targets: public landing hero matched to the user's service business
service category image or staff/resource portrait set
media_plan.guidance: Generate imagery only when it improves the public landing. Keep admin pages utilitarian; do not generate decorative admin images unless there is an empty-state need.

agent_instructions: Use this template when the user needs a reservations, appointments, agenda or booking app. Do not mention the internal template name to the end user. Preserve the mixed surface: public landing and booking flow plus protected admin. Reuse existing DYPAI endpoints and tables for services, resources, availability, customers and bookings. Public booking/contact actions must use public endpoints; admin management stays protected.

fonts.display: Inter with strong weights for booking landing headings

palette.intent: clean SaaS booking app: blue primary + pale blue accent

design_system.guidance: Keep the UI clean, operational and appointment-focused. Retune HSL tokens in src/index.css for the vertical (barberia: charcoal/gold, wellness: sage/cream, consulting: navy/cyan) without changing the token structure.
